svg.title: One shelf, from the gap to the fix
svg.desc: Example data: a test shelf of 216 products. 1, the problem: 357 fields are missing and 94 products cannot be told apart. 2, the audit: each attribute is scored against 32 shopper requirements. 3, the priority: ranked by bits of decision information, screen size comes first and processor is only third, although 162 products miss it. 4, the repair: screen size is recorded on all 216 products, and 185 of 216 can now be told apart, up from 122.

g.text: Ranked by bits of decision information
216 test-shelf products: 94 cannot be told apart. 357 fields are missing.
Every attribute is scored against 32 shopper requirements.
Screen size comes first. Processor, the emptiest, is only third.
Screen size recorded on all 216: 185 products can now be told apart, up from 122.
